candidates.statement: Checkout 502s are caused by payment authorization calls timing out (~2s ReadTimeout), propagating through order to gateway; payment is the slow downstream dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/traces were not admitted; payment latency is inferred from client-side ReadTimeout spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s) while inventory/redis succeed, and gateway/order 502s align with ~2s durations. Payment is the only failing dependency in the checkout path, supporting downstream-latency. Payment-side telemetry is missing, so confidence is bounded.
missing_evidence: Payment service metrics (latency, error rate) to confirm payment-side slowness
Payment service traces/logs for the authorization route
Order service traces (excluded) to confirm timeout propagation path
